source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Starting with the Defender, teams take turns setting up units:

- 1 unit per turn, wholly within the team's deployment zone, leaving out units in **[strategic reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**
- after setting up a **TITANIC** unit, the team skips its next set-up turn
- once one team has set up all its units, the other sets up the rest of its own

detail.finish: the other side sets up all units still due to deploy
